tablescraper-selected-row: Listen to another language with Transcribe mode

In Transcribe Mode, your Pixel Buds continuously translate spoken language into your ear, and a transcript appears on your phone. You can translate from English to French, German, Italian, or Spanish.
Use the transcribe feature in a quiet environment with one person speaking at a time for the best accuracy.

zippy-content: Step 1: Ask Google Assistant to help transcribe with Google Pixel Buds
zippy-content 2: While you're wearing Pixel Buds, press and hold either earbud or say, "Hey Google."
zippy-content 3: Request assistance, such as "Ayúdame a entender inglés."
zippy-content 4: This launches Google Translate in transcribe mode listening to the language you request (English) and translating to your default language (French, German, Italian or Spanish).
zippy-content 6: Listen through your Pixel Buds along with the transcript on your phone. The text is read aloud after each sentence is translated.

zippy-content 4: At the bottom left corner, select the language you want to listen to (supported language: English).
zippy-content 5: At the bottom right corner, select the language with the spoken words to be translated into (supported languages: French, German, Italian or Spanish).

tablescraper-selected-row: Move closer to the audio source.
tablescraper-selected-row 2: Ask the speaker to talk louder, slower, or more clearly.
